plan.environment: the shelter dining hall exactly as rendered in this episode: grey institutional walls, one long wooden table running to a single far doorway, brown chairs on both sides, a blue-tiled counter on the right, tall windows on the left with warm afternoon light
plan.emotional_guidance: Valence: proud, warm, careful. Arousal: calm.
plan.visual_style: finished full-colour 3D animation, identical in look, lighting and character design to the first frame; never a sketch

audio.sounds: P01 a crayon pressed onto paper in small careful dabs; P02 a soft chair creak as Maria sits back; P03 a light paper rustle
audio.room: the big hall in warm afternoon air, close soft table sounds

panels.video_beat: Maria colours the chest lights of the robot in her drawing carefully, one by one
she lifts her crayon and sits back a little, admiring her drawing with a small proud smile
the boy beside her glances over at her drawing

plan.continuity: Maria in her window-side seat at the long table; the crayon boy in the next seat on her screen-right; a girl with braids at the far right edge behind the crayon bucket
preventions: one long table with the white paper runner, never small separate tables
the camera stays still or drifts gently; no cut
the drawing keeps the girl, the dog and the robot

design: same-view FLF between two keyframes of one shot; hard cut from the original take
